summary: CORS fix on /app/backend/server.py verified. All 49 parametrized pytest cases passed (0.26s). Every passing origin (malta.quakeangel.app, safequake.onrender.com, quakeangel.app, www.quakeangel.app, london.quakeangel.app via regex, http://localhost:5173 via regex) gets its Origin echoed in Access-Control-Allow-Origin on OPTIONS preflight AND actual GET for /api/devices and /api/audit?limit=50, plus OPTIONS on /api/mark-rescued and /api/trigger-alert. All three rejected origins (evil.example.com, http://malta.quakeangel.app, https://quakeangel.app.evil.com) are correctly refused — no ACAO echoed. GET /api/devices returns a real body with a 'devices' array. Regex is properly anchored (^...$) so the spoofed suffix quakeangel.app.evil.com does not match, and http-scheme malta subdomain does not match either. Backend-only test as requested; no frontend touched.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS config in /app/backend/server.py lines 1567-1584 is well-structured: explicit allow_origins for stable production hosts + regex for dev/localhost and dynamic city subdomains. Regex is properly anchored with ^ and $ so quakeangel.app.evil.com cannot spoof. Character class [a-z0-9-] disallows dots in the subdomain segment, so multi-level spoofs like a.b.quakeangel.app also would not match — this is intentional and correct; if multi-level subdomains are needed in future, the regex will need a small tweak.
allow_credentials=True combined with a specific allow_origins list (never '*') is the correct pattern — Starlette will echo the exact Origin, which is what we verified.
Considered: server.py is 1597 lines, exceeds the >700-line guideline and should be split into routers/modules — but that is outside the scope of this CORS-only review.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS allowlist for QuakeGuard/Quake Angel backend was expanded to cover the new custom domain malta.quakeangel.app plus a regex for https://<sub>.quakeangel.app and http://localhost:<port>. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_cors_iteration_24.py covers 6 passing origins and 3 rejected origins against /api/devices, /api/audit, /api/mark-rescued, /api/trigger-alert. Re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_cors_iteration_24.py -v
rca_of_issue: Original bug: dashboard on malta.quakeangel.app got its browser CORS preflight rejected because that origin was not in Starlette CORSMiddleware allow_origins (only safequake.onrender.com was) nor matched by the previous localhost-only regex. Fix (verified): explicit list now includes malta.quakeangel.app + apex + www, and regex broadened to r'^(http://localhost:\d+|https://[a-z0-9-]+\.quakeangel\.app)$'. Verified by curl-equivalent (requests) OPTIONS+GET with Origin headers — all 6 approved origins have their Origin echoed in Access-Control-Allow-Origin; all 3 malicious/misformed origins correctly get no ACAO.
